Dear Anna,

Thank you for sending the revised PO NW‑45120 Rev.1. We acknowledge your request to adopt this revision and discard the previous version.

We note that the new delivery date of 30 Nov 2026 creates a capacity shortfall (13,500 pcs required vs 9,314 pcs available), and the order value increases by USD 7,275 (+12.5 %) to USD 65,475.00.

To move forward we can propose:
- Full quantity shipped by the earliest feasible date 2026‑12‑08, or
- A split shipment: 9,300 pcs by 30 Nov 2026 and the remaining 4,200 pcs by 2026‑12‑08.

Please confirm which option works for you, or let us know any alternative you prefer.

Best regards,  
Karthik  
Merchandiser  
Sri Velan Knits

Buyer order changes: PO NW-45120 Rev.1 replaces prior version; total quantity increased to 13,500 pcs (from 12,000); delivery date advanced to 2026-11-30 (from 2026-12-15); Navy colour quantity raised to 6,000 pcs (from 4,500); unit price remains USD 4.85; style NW-TS-2207; Incoterms FOB Tuticorin; destination Hamburg, Germany.

Risk findings: Delivery high severity – current plan infeasible (13,500 pcs needed vs 9,314 pcs free capacity before 30 Nov 2026, 4,186 pcs shortfall). Price high severity – contract value increased 12.5% (+USD 7,275) to USD 65,475. Quantity medium severity – total quantity up 12.5% and Navy up 33.3%.

Decision needed: Management must confirm whether to accept revised PO Rev.1 and approve any required capacity adjustments or cost implications.

Production: Hold all planning and material procurement for PO NW-45120 Rev.1 until buyer confirms acceptance; do not proceed based on prior version. Prepare to review capacity options if approved.
